consequence.statement: The gate is permanently enabled; environments that disabled it can no longer do so and get the enabled behavior.

original.statement: The ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure feature gate moves to GA and is permanently enabled; it can no longer be disabled.

decision.reason: [ev-173f5593d910] says only that the ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure gate goes GA and is permanently enabled, with no way to disable it. Environments that had it disabled therefore get the enabled behavior. The evidence doesn't say anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, and it doesn't say whether an explicit disable flag is silently ignored or rejected. Given that, behavior-change (review) with low severity is the claim the text supports without over-claiming mandatory work, although setting-ignored (P3) is a reasonable alternative reading.
